name: Survival
core_loop: Gather wood, stone and food while the light holds
Craft the next tool the valley demands
Eat and rest before the meters bite
Hole up or fight through the night, then repeat

questions.question: What counts as beating a run?
Should the world run a day and night cycle?
What is the main thing trying to kill the player?

acceptance.promise: Hunger drains on the clock, food refills it, and an empty meter costs health.
setup: Start a run at full hunger and stamina
Place one food resource within reach
probes: Advance the clock sixty seconds and read hunger
Eat the food and read hunger
Advance the clock until hunger empties and read health
evidence: Hunger falls at hunger_rate per second
Eating raises hunger and never above its maximum
Health falls only once hunger has reached zero

acceptance.promise: Stalkers appear only at night and stop spawning at dawn.
setup: Set day_length to a short authored value
Place the player in the open valley
probes: Run a full day segment and count spawns
Run a full night segment and count spawns
Read the sun angle at each transition
evidence: No stalker spawns during the day segment
Stalkers spawn during the night segment at spawn_interval
The sun angle crosses the horizon exactly twice per day_length
